_help: Rules for spotting benchmark pieces. A result matches when it is a single piece (not intervals) of the given distance (meters) or time (minutes, within 5 s). max_rate/min_rate check the average stroke rate. min_effort requires watts at least that multiple of your median easy-piece watts over the prior 60 days (keeps 30-min UT2 rows out of the 30r20 list). Tag a logbook comment with #<id> (e.g. #30r20) to force a match, or #notest to exclude a piece.

steady_state._help: Pieces used for the W/HR efficiency trend: continuous, at least min_minutes long, at or under max_rate, with heart rate recorded.
steady_state._windows_help: The chart can measure just the first N minutes of each piece (from its splits), so long and short pieces compare fairly. default_window picks the starting view.

athlete._help: Coach's reference values. Zones are upper bounds in bpm; the last zone is everything above.

goals.label: Holiday Challenge
goals._note: Erg only, no catchup, like Concept2's own count.

goals.label: 1,000,000 m
goals._note: Scope pending Sam; default erg + water.

session_types._help: Coach's rules for typing erg sessions, HR-first for continuous pieces. Order: test -> steady -> threshold -> race_pace -> other. A Logbook comment tag (#steady #threshold #race #test #other) always wins. Splits are /500m over work intervals only. HR below min_valid_hr counts as missing: pace rules apply and the type is marked low-confidence.
